notes: Account background: Tier-1 critical infrastructure contractor for regional emergency comms; runs multiple contact centers in SCIFs and a separate DR site.
Needs: air-gapped model hosting, deterministic latency under incident surges, tool-calling integration to Avaya ACD + custom operator consoles, full audit trail for operator actions.

Security: Must support FIPS HSM with on-prem KMS, STIG-hardening checklist, logs forwarded to internal SIEM (Splunk) with preserved chain-of-custody. No model weights can leave facility; only metrics/telemetry allowed with redaction.
Quote from CISO (paraphrase): "We will only consider solutions that can live inside our SCIF and pass the STIG baseline. Anything that reaches public internet is a non-starter."
POC constraints: All test images run on isolated subnet; no external inference calls. Redwood private deployment required. Benchmarks must include 99th pct latency under 10x baseline traffic spike.
Pricing sensitivity: mid-high — willing to pay premium for air-gap support and SLA-backed latency guarantees during incident spikes.
Integration notes: Existing CTI/CRM connectors are legacy SOAP endpoints; SE flagged need for custom tool-calling adapter. Also require webhook-style action approvals recorded in ticketing system.
Regulatory notes: Some workloads flagged for export-control review — procurement needs vendor attestations for model provenance and third-party libs.
Internal AE notes: "Ravi and Alexei ran technical kickoff. SE to deliver adapter spec by 2026-02-28. Legal asked for sample BAA and SOC2 artifact pack."
Preferred models: Closed-off LLM variants with quantization options; preference for deterministic sampling and temperature controls for operator-facing suggestions.

Operational expectations: Canaries for rollouts inside air-gapped environment, ability to rollback to a smaller capacity model under heavy load, full KV cache controls to avoid persistence of sensitive prefixes.

Success metrics for POC: 1) avg agent assist latency < 150ms at steady state, 2) 99th latency < 450ms during 10x surge, 3) generated summary accuracy > 85% on labeled ticket set, 4) end-to-end auditability demonstrated.
